package mergecasual

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestMergeCasualCatalogReloadIsAtomicAndExistingBoardFrozen(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	write := func(r Rules) {
		t.Helper()
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(r)
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "merge.json"), raw, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	write(DemoRules())
	store, err := OpenCatalog(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	snap := store.Current()
	old, err := CaptureRules(snap)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	bad := old
	bad.EnergyMillis = 0
	write(bad)
	if _, err := store.Reload(context.Background()); err == nil || store.Current() != snap {
		t.Fatal("invalid config published")
	}
	patched := old
	patched.Version = "merge-v2"
	patched.OrderGold = 99
	write(patched)
	if _, err := store.Reload(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fresh, err := CaptureRules(store.Current())
	if err != nil || fresh == old {
		t.Fatal("reload absent")
	}
	s, err := NewState(strings.Repeat("ab", 32), 1800000000000, old)
	if err != nil || s.ConfigHash == fresh.Hash() || s.Rules != old {
		t.Fatal("old board changed")
	}
	if still, err := CaptureRules(snap); err != nil || still != old {
		t.Fatal("old snapshot mutated")
	}
}
func TestMergeCasualMalformedStateFailsClosedAndPublicViewExcludesSecrets(t *testing.T) {
	s, err := NewState(strings.Repeat("ab", 32), 1800000000000, DemoRules())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, raw := range []string{s.Encode() + "{}", strings.Replace(s.Encode(), `"Schema":1`, `"Schema":0`, 1), strings.Replace(s.Encode(), `"Gold":30`, `"Gold":-1`, 1), strings.Replace(s.Encode(), `"Level":1`, `"Level":9`, 1), strings.Replace(s.Encode(), `"Energy":10`, `"UnknownEnergy":10`, 1), strings.Replace(s.Encode(), `"ConfigHash":"`, `"ConfigHash":"wrong`, 1)} {
		if _, err := Decode(raw); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("malformed state accepted")
		}
	}
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(s.View())
	for _, private := range []string{s.Key, "Key", "Receipts", "Ads", "EnergyAt", "Rules"} {
		if strings.Contains(string(raw), private) {
			t.Fatal("private field in view", private)
		}
	}
	view := s.View()
	view.Board[0].Item.Level = 4
	if s.Board[0].Item.Level != 1 {
		t.Fatal("view aliases private state")
	}
}
func TestMergeCasualBoundedLedgerRetainsOldReceiptsAndRejectsOverflow(t *testing.T) {
	s, err := NewState(strings.Repeat("ab", 32), 1800000000000, DemoRules())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var first Receipt
	for i := 1; i <= LedgerLimit; i++ {
		r, err := s.Apply(Command{Epoch: 1, Seq: uint64(i), Base: s.Revision, Kind: "recover"}, s.LastAt)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if i == 1 {
			first = r
		}
	}
	before := s.Digest()
	if _, err := s.Apply(Command{Epoch: 1, Seq: LedgerLimit + 1, Base: s.Revision, Kind: "produce", A: 10}, s.LastAt); err == nil || s.Digest() != before {
		t.Fatal("full ledger evicted evidence")
	}
	if got, err := s.Apply(first.Command, s.LastAt+3600000); err != nil || got != first || s.Digest() != before {
		t.Fatal("full ledger lost old receipt")
	}
	if _, err := Decode(s.Encode()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s.Gold = ValueLimit
	local := s
	local.Receipts = nil
	local.Revision = 1
	if _, err := local.Apply(Command{Epoch: 1, Seq: 1, Base: 1, Kind: "sell", A: 0}, s.LastAt); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("gold overflow accepted")
	}
}
